title: Asian option with a control variate
pickerTitle: Asian option with a control variate
line: The geometric average cuts the error for the same paths.
description: An arithmetic-average Asian call has no closed form. The geometric-average version does, and its payoff tracks the arithmetic one closely, so it makes a control variate that cuts the error for the same number of paths.
thumbnailAlt: Arithmetic against geometric Asian payoffs, nearly on one line, rendered by RunMat
